channel.title: ahk02x — field notes
channel.description: Engineering write-ups by Amir Khademi: car telemetry, home infrastructure, and tools that have to earn your trust.

item.title: Everything I ever kept
item.description: Amir Khademi ran a file-system survey across his own archive — 127,206 files going back to 1998 — and wrote down what the data said: two years that turned out to be software rather than him, three years he kept nothing, why he logs his own car, and why the systems have to be his.

item.title: Internal is not internet
item.description: How Amir Khademi built lanwatch, a two-collector tool that reports a home network's device-to-device traffic and its internet traffic as separate facts, after finding the firewall could not see one and double-counted the other.

item.title: The part matters, not the store
item.description: How Amir Khademi watches classifieds every fifteen minutes and fifty-two store prices every hour for a short list of Audi SQ5 parts, and gets one message when something actually moves.

item.title: The timer firing is not evidence
item.description: How Amir Khademi set up a fortnightly, unattended patch cycle for a small Proxmox home fleet, and why it earns a green only for what actually updated and came back, never for the schedule having run.

item.title: Memory as infrastructure
item.description: How Amir Khademi runs an AI coding agent's memory as infrastructure: one fact per Markdown file, an index of triggers, a linter in the commit hook, nightly checks against the real machines, and git for the history.

item.title: The wall stays red until I say so
item.description: How Amir Khademi turned a portrait monitor into the alarm surface for his home fleet: an alert overlay that latches until a human clears it, a feed that admits when it is dead, and a screen that stops rendering for an empty room.

item.title: I gave Claude Code a pager
item.description: How Amir Khademi made an AI coding agent accountable for a home fleet's alerts: a board built by cron, four hook rungs, an acknowledgement ledger with verdict words, and a headless responder.
